# Pre-Tasks Requirements Quality Checklist: Wind Plant CTF Capture

**Purpose**: Formal requirements-quality gate for the author before `/speckit-tasks` — validates completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability across capture flow, hub/`plantTool` contracts, and runtime/config/logging requirements (not implementation verification).

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all hub actions required for a successful capture (`start`, `get`, `getResult`, `config`, `unlockCodeGenerator`, `done`) explicitly required in the written requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Contract hub-windpower]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for both single-point and batch `config` shapes, including which shape is preferred? [Completeness, Contract hub-windpower, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements specified for every `get` param value (`weather`, `turbinecheck`, `powerplantcheck`, `documentation`) including which are async vs inline? [Completeness, Contract hub-windpower]
- [x] CHK004 Are credential/setup-failure requirements defined for missing `HUB_API_KEY` and missing `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` separately or as a unified setup failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Contract application-config] — unified setup failure documented
- [x] CHK005 Are logging requirements specified for both plant tool I/O and model communication (system prompt, tool definitions, user prompt, response)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan/research logging decision]
- [x] CHK006 Are parameterization requirements complete for attempt limit, HTTP URLs, system prompt location, and LLM model name? [Completeness, Contract application-config]
- [x] CHK007 Are out-of-scope boundaries documented so pre-tasks work does not expand into GUIs, servers, or multi-plant support? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the windstorm threshold stated with an unambiguous comparison operator (`>=` vs `>`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Is “hour precision only” defined such that minutes and seconds MUST be zero in configuration times? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Is “necessary hours only” defined so calm/unused hours are explicitly excluded from the batch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK011 Is post-storm default reset defined as storm occurrence hour + 1h given occurrence-only forecast items (no end time)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK012 Is “attempt” defined as counting only when a new `start` is required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Is the success flag format specified precisely enough to recognize `{FLG:...}` in a `done` response? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract hub-windpower flag pattern]
- [x] CHK014 Is “appropriate pitch” / idle vs max-production pitch sourced from documented requirements (report/docs) rather than left undefined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021] — closed: MUST from hub docs/turbine payloads; missing → fail attempt
- [x] CHK015 Is the mapping from spec phrasing “turbine checked” to hub `get(param=turbinecheck)` (+ `getResult`) stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, research.md Decision]
